resources.string: Suggests and corrects as you type
It takes less than a minute.
Your phone settings will open. Turn on “Aurebesh” and come back here.
Android will warn you that a keyboard can see what you type. That warning appears for any new keyboard. With Aurebesh, what you type stays on your phone.
Tap the button and pick “Aurebesh” from the list.
Type something in the “Try it” card.
Not convinced? Hold the space bar and you are back on your previous keyboard.
You can now use it in WhatsApp, Instagram and any other app. To go back to your previous keyboard, hold the space bar.
Each key also shows its normal letter.
The normal letter goes away by itself on the keys you already use with ease.
What you type stays on your phone. No data is collected or sent to anyone. The app only uses the internet when you ask it to, for the AI assistant, which is optional.
See what is stored and how to delete it
Your data doesn\'t leave this phone
To help you, the keyboard keeps here what you copy, the words it learns from you and your shortcuts. You can see it and delete it whenever you want.
Each symbol with its normal letter and its name.
It swaps the drawing on the keys for the Star Wars alphabet (Aurebesh). What you type comes out in normal letters: whoever gets your message won\'t notice a thing.
How do I go back to my previous keyboard?
Hold the space bar and choose your usual keyboard. You can switch between them whenever you want.
How do I remove it completely?
Uninstall the app like any other: hold its icon and tap “Uninstall”. Your previous keyboard comes back by itself.
My phone said the app may be harmful

It is the Google Play Protect warning for apps installed from outside the store that it doesn\'t know yet. It is more insistent with a keyboard, because a keyboard sees what you type. This app collects and sends nothing, and its code is public. Install it only if you downloaded it from the project\'s official page.
It doesn\'t show on the Flip\'s cover screen
The keyboard only uses the internet if you download an AI model or connect your own server. On your phone it keeps what you copy, the words it learns and the models you download.
It corrects, summarizes, translates or writes for you from the keyboard\'s ✦ button. It is optional: the keyboard works just the same without it.
